Instruments.pedal steel: Pedal steel guitar is prominent in the arrangements.
Instruments.fiddle: Fiddle or violin plays a lead or featured role.
Instruments.slide guitar: Bottleneck or lap-steel slide guitar is a signature texture.
Instruments.drum machine: Programmed drums are a defining texture.
Instruments.fingerpicked acoustic: Fingerstyle acoustic guitar is the core of the sound.

Guitar.Crazy Horse fuzz: Loose, thick, distorted electric guitar in the Neil Young & Crazy Horse mold.
Guitar.harmonized guitars: Twin or triple lead guitars in harmony (Allmans, Skynyrd, Thin Lizzy line).
Guitar.jangle: Bright, ringing, chiming clean electric guitar.
Guitar.noise wall: Massed distortion and feedback used as texture.
Guitar.Telecaster twang: Bright, snappy country lead guitar (Bakersfield and honky-tonk style).

Voice.drawl: Southern or rural accent shapes the singing.
Voice.close harmonies: Tight vocal harmonies (Everly/Louvin style or band harmonies).

Writing.funny-sad: Jokes and grief in the same verse (Prine/Berman line).
Writing.Southern gothic: Dark, grotesque, or religious Southern imagery.
Writing.pop-culture references: Named brands, athletes, TV, and pop ephemera.
Writing.heartbreak: Breakups and lost love as the main subject.
Writing.drinking songs: Bars, hangovers, and drinking as setting or subject.
Writing.spiritual or gospel: Religious or gospel themes and forms.

Production.lo-fi: Home-recorded, tape hiss, deliberately rough sound.
Production.live in the room: Full-band live-to-tape feel with little overdubbing.
Production.long songs (7+ minutes): At least one song over seven minutes.
